name: Contiv-VPP
description: A Kubernetes CNI plugin employing FD.io VPP as a programmable CNF vSwitch, offering high-performance cloud-native networking and services for Kubernetes clusters.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker folder contains Docker files and scripts for building Contiv-VPP Docker images (also available on Dockerhub). Deploys as system PODs in kube-system namespace.

eval_notes: Kubernetes-native VPP networking. Good for testing CNI plugin scenarios and high-performance container networking. Vagrant-based development environment available.
